rows.text: {"scene":"A kitchen area featuring a stovetop, backsplash, and upper cabinets.","observations":[{"object":"Upper cabinets","visibleDetail":"Wood-grain surface with dark, decorative hinges and vertical handles","location":"Top portion of the scene","uncertainty":"None"},{"object":"Range hood","visibleDetail":"Black horizontal structure with an integrated light fixture that is illuminated","location":"Below the cabinets and above the backsplash","uncertainty":"None"},{"object":"Backsplash","visibleDetail":"Grid pattern of light-colored square tiles with dark grout lines","location":"Between the range hood and the stovetop","uncertainty":"None"},{"object":"Plume","visibleDetail":"A wispy, greyish-blue vertical column","location":"Rising from the left side of the stovetop towards the range hood, in front of the tiles","uncertainty":"Whether it is steam or smoke is not certain"},{"object":"Stovetop","visibleDetail":"Metal surface containing multiple circular electric coil burners and a set of control knobs","location":"Bottom portion of the scene","uncertainty":"None"},{"object":"Kettle","visibleDetail":"Black, reflective object with a handle","location":"On the left side of the stovetop","uncertainty":"None"},{"object":"Jar","visibleDetail":"White container with a dark pattern","location":"On the right side of the stovetop","uncertainty":"None"}],"limitations":["Low image resolution limits fine detail visibility.","The exact composition of the plume cannot be determined."]}
